# ToolKiti — Complete API Reference for AI Agents
> https://www.toolkiti.org | 2026-08-02

## About
Structured API directory. 41 APIs, 79 categories. EN/ZH.

## API Endpoints
- Catalog: https://www.toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools
- Search: https://www.toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools/search?q=
- Compare: https://www.toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools/compare?ids=
- Categories: https://www.toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools/categories

## Complete Catalog
### 1. OpenAI API | llm | pay-as-you-go (per token)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/openai | Access GPT-4o, GPT-4, GPT-3.5, embeddings, DALL-E, Whisper, and TTS models via REST API.
Tags: llm, chat, embeddings, vision, audio

### 2. Anthropic Claude API | llm | pay-as-you-go (per token)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/anthropic | Access Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Haiku, and Opus models for chat, analysis, and code generation.
Tags: llm, chat, analysis

### 3. Google Gemini API | llm | free tier available, pay-as-you-go
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/google-gemini | Access Gemini 2.0 Flash, Pro, and Ultra models with native multimodal and tool-use support.
Tags: llm, multimodal, vision

### 4. DeepSeek API | llm | pay-as-you-go (per token, very low cost)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/deepseek | Access DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-R1 reasoning models with competitive pricing.
Tags: llm, reasoning, chat

### 5. Mistral AI API | llm | pay-as-you-go (per token)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/mistral | Access Mistral Large, Small, and Codestral models with efficient architecture.
Tags: llm, chat, code

### 6. Cohere API | llm | free tier available, pay-as-you-go
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/cohere | Access Command-R, Embed, and Rerank models for enterprise NLP and search.
Tags: llm, embedding, search, rerank

### 7. Groq API | llm | free tier available, pay-as-you-go
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/groq | Ultra-fast inference API for open-source LLMs using LPU inference engine.
Tags: llm, inference, speed

### 8. Together AI API | llm | pay-as-you-go (per token)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/together-ai | Cloud platform for open-source LLM inference with 100+ models including Llama, Mixtral, and DeepSeek.
Tags: llm, inference, open-source

### 9. Replicate API | ml | pay-as-you-go (per prediction)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/replicate | Run open-source ML models in the cloud. Supports Llama, Stable Diffusion, Whisper, and thousands more.
Tags: ml, inference, open-source

### 10. Stability AI API | image | pay-as-you-go (per image)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/stability-ai | Generate images with Stable Diffusion 3, SDXL, and image-to-video models.
Tags: image, generation, stable-diffusion

### 11. ElevenLabs API | audio | free tier available, pay-as-you-go
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/elevenlabs | Text-to-speech, voice cloning, and sound effects generation with ultra-realistic voices.
Tags: audio, tts, voice-cloning

### 12. AssemblyAI API | audio | free tier available, pay-as-you-go
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/assemblyai | Speech-to-text, speaker diarization, sentiment analysis, and content moderation.
Tags: audio, stt, transcription

### 13. Hugging Face Inference API | ml | free tier, pay-as-you-go for accelerated inference
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/huggingface | Access 200,000+ models for inference including transformers, diffusion, and audio models.
Tags: ml, transformers, inference

### 14. Perplexity API | llm | pay-as-you-go, subscription available
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/perplexity | Access Sonar search-grounded LLMs with real-time web search and citations.
Tags: llm, search, real-time

### 15. Pinecone Vector Database | vector-db | free tier available, pay-as-you-go
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/pinecone | Managed vector database for semantic search, RAG, and recommendation with millisecond latency.
Tags: vector-db, search, rag

### 16. Weaviate Vector Database | vector-db | free tier (cloud sandbox), pay-as-you-go, self-hosted
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/weaviate | Open-source vector database with built-in vectorization, hybrid search, and GraphQL API.
Tags: vector-db, search, open-source

### 17. Qdrant Vector Database | vector-db | free tier (cloud), pay-as-you-go, self-hosted (free)
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/qdrant | High-performance vector search engine written in Rust, for semantic search and recommendations.
Tags: vector-db, search, rust

### 18. Modal GPU Cloud | cloud-gpu | pay-as-you-go (per second), free tier available
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/modal | Serverless GPU compute platform for AI inference, batch processing, and model deployment.
Tags: cloud, gpu, serverless

### 19. RunPod GPU Cloud | cloud-gpu | pay-as-you-go (per hour/sec), cheap spot instances
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/runpod | GPU cloud platform with serverless endpoints, pods, and auto-scaling for AI workloads.
Tags: cloud, gpu, serverless

### 20. LangChain Framework | tools | open-source (free), LangSmith/LangGraph Cloud have paid tiers
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/langchain | Framework for building LLM-powered applications with chains, agents, RAG, and tool integration.

### 21. Tavily Search API | search | free tier (1000 credits/mo), pay-as-you-go

### 22. Brave Search API | search | free tier (2000 queries/mo), paid plans

### 23. Serper API | search | free tier (2500 queries), pay-as-you-go from $50/mo

### 24. Jina AI API | search | free tier, pay-as-you-go

### 25. Exa Search API | search | free tier (1000 queries/mo), paid plans
URL: https://www.toolkiti.org/tools/exa | AI-powered search engine built for embeddings-based semantic search. Finds content by meaning, not keywords.

### 26. Firecrawl API | search | free tier (500 pages/mo), paid plans

### 27. Midjourney API | image | subscription ($10-$60/mo), API via third-party

### 28. Leonardo.AI API | image | free tier (150 tokens/day), paid plans

### 29. Ideogram API | image | free tier, paid plans from $20/mo

### 30. GitHub REST & GraphQL API | tools | free (5000 req/hr for authenticated), unlimited for public repos

### 31. Supabase API | tools | free tier (2 projects, 500 MB DB), paid plans

### 32. Resend API | tools | free tier (3000 emails/mo for first 3 months), paid plans

### 38. RunwayML API | image | free tier (credits), Standard $15/mo, Pro $35/mo, Unlimited $100/mo
